Cost: 1,000eb (Very Expensive)
Type: Cyberarm
Install: Clinic
Humanity Loss: 7 (2d6)
Option Slots: uses 1

Paired Cyberhands. Requires paired Cyberarms. They install together and count as one item for Cost and Humanity Loss, but not for Critical Injuries or repair. As an Action the user raises their hands and makes an Autofire (Machine Pistol 3) attack against everything within 10m/yds. The attack gets nothing from the user's Role Abilities or items, but installed cyberware still helps. It holds one loaded attack; reloading needs 20 rounds of any SMG ammunition, a DV17 Cybertech or Surgery check, and one hour.

Foundry notes:

  • One item for the pair, as Corgo prices and installs them together.
  • Corgo gives no damage line, so it uses the SMG's 2d6 with Autofire 3 (Machine Pistol). Adjust if your table reads it differently.
  • The area attack against everything within 10m/yds is resolved by hand; the sheet rolls it as one Autofire attack.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > Cyberarms).
